test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, MIRROR is written as NRIILI. How will MOBILE be written as in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ef23e4e1d51f1d6fa6cc781e85a1def568fa4aad3a2f45c80bf311c66527165.png] 

Here, **each letter is replaced by the letter which have same positional value in reverse alphabetical order.**

So, the code for Mirror will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59684ca79c7ab26709857084cf5e275a244c87da3675076e17b41b69fd3ad80c.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **The code for MOBILE will be:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a80d118bd004e5f71eca5012c68ce6abc7f0daaf2f1f912a71927fc4a408fb16.png] 

Hence, **NLYROV** is the correct answer.
